68522-life-of-liszt.title: Life Of Liszt
68522-life-of-liszt.creator: Louis Nohl
68522-life-of-liszt.description: A book by Louis Nohl. In reproducing the selections from Miss Amy Fay’s “Music Study in Germany,” which appear in the closing chapter of this volume, the translator, so far as has been practicable, for the German version does not follow the English very closely in its connection, or always literally, has made use of the original text.

arxiv-2104-11529.title: Cosmological time and the constants of nature
arxiv-2104-11529.creator: João Magueijo
arxiv-2104-11529.description: Abstract We propose that cosmological time is effectively the conjugate of the constants of nature. Different definitions of time arise, with the most relevant related to the constant controlling the dynamics in each epoch. The Hamiltonian constraint then becomes a Schrodinger equation.

arxiv-2107-02625.title: Open-Source LiDAR Time Synchronization System by Mimicking GNSS-clock
arxiv-2107-02625.creator: Marsel Faizullin 1 , Anastasiia Kornilova 2 and Gonzalo Ferrer 3
arxiv-2107-02625.description: Abstract Data fusion algorithms that employ LiDAR measurements, such as Visual-LiDAR, LiDAR-Inertial, or Multiple LiDAR Odometry and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) rely on precise timestamping schemes that grant synchronicity to data from LiDAR and other sensors. Poor synchronization performance, due to incorrect timestamping procedure, may negatively affect the algorithms’ state estimation results.

arxiv-2112-03039.title: Refined blow-up asymptotics for a perturbed nonlinear heat equation with a gradient and a non-local term
arxiv-2112-03039.creator: Bouthaina Abdelhedi
arxiv-2112-03039.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bouthaina Abdelhedi. We consider in this paper a perturbation of the standard semilinear heat equation by a term involving the space derivative and a non-local term. In some earlier works [ 1 , 2 ] , we constructed a solution u u for that equation such that u u and ∇ u \nabla u both blow up at the origin and only there. We also gave the final blow-up profile.

arxiv-2405-00206.title: Verlinde Series for Hirzebruch Surfaces
arxiv-2405-00206.creator: Ian Cavey
arxiv-2405-00206.description: Abstract We give an explicit formula for Euler characteristics of line bundles on the Hilbert scheme of points on ℙ 1 × ℙ 1 \mathbb{P}^{1}\times\mathbb{P}^{1} . Combined with structural results of Ellingsrud, Göttsche, and Lehn [ 5 ] , this determines the Euler characteristic of any line bundle on the Hilbert scheme of points on any smooth, projective surface.

arxiv-2409-06921.title: Voltage Mining for (De)lithiation-stabilized Cathodes and a Machine Learning Model for Li-ion Cathode Voltage
arxiv-2409-06921.creator: Haoming Howard Li, Qian Chen, Gerbrand Ceder, Kristin A. Persson
arxiv-2409-06921.description: Abstract Advances in lithium-metal anodes have inspired interest in discovery of Li-free cathodes, most of which are natively found in their charged state. This is in contrast to today’s commercial lithium-ion battery cathodes, which are more stable in their discharged state.

arxiv-2509-11119.title: On the common index jump theorem and further developments
arxiv-2509-11119.creator: Huagui Duan, Yiming Long, Wei Wang, Chaofeng Zhu
arxiv-2509-11119.description: Abstract In [ LZ02 ] , Long and Zhu established originally the common index jump theorem (CIJT) for symplectic paths in 2002, which was later generalized to its enhanced version (ECIJT) by Duan, Long and Wang in [ DLW16 ] in 2016.

pmc-10573000.title: Xanthones Isolated from Cratoxylum cochinchinensis Reduced Oxidative Stress in Periodontal Ligament Stem Cells
pmc-10573000.creator: Nisarat Ruangsawasdi, Nawong Boonnak, Chareerut Pruksaniyom, Pirasut Rodanant, Claudiu T Supuran
pmc-10573000.description: Xanthone compounds from Cratoxylum cochinchinensis (C. cochinchinensis) have demonstrated antioxidant effects and potency in treating many inflammatory diseases. However, the efficiency of the three xanthone extracts isolated from the young fruit of this plant, i.e., two geranyloxy xanthones (F6, F8) and one 1,3,7-hydroxy xanthone (F137), as antioxidants and therapeutics for periodontal disease has not been evaluated.

pmc-10715316.title: Lanosterol Synthase Prevents EMT During Lens Epithelial Fibrosis Via Regulating SREBP1
pmc-10715316.creator: Pengjuan Ma, Jingqi Huang, Baoxin Chen, Mi Huang, Lang Xiong, Jieping Chen, Shan Huang, Yizhi Liu
pmc-10715316.description: PurposeEpithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT) of lens epithelial cells (LECs) is a predominant pathological process underlying fibrotic cataracts. Here we investigated the role and mechanism of lanosterol synthase (LSS), a key rate-limiting enzyme in sterol biosynthesis, in EMT of LECs.MethodsHuman lens epithelial explants, primary rabbit LECs, and whole rat lenses were treated with TGFβ2.

pmc-11515661.title: Translation regulation by RNA stem-loops can reduce gene expression noise
pmc-11515661.creator: Candan Çelik, Pavol Bokes, Abhyudai Singh
pmc-11515661.description: BackgroundStochastic modelling plays a crucial role in comprehending the dynamics of intracellular events in various biochemical systems, including gene-expression models. Cell-to-cell variability arises from the stochasticity or noise in the levels of gene products such as messenger RNA (mRNA) and protein. The sources of noise can stem from different factors, including structural elements.

pmc-11646404.title: Influence of Work-Life Balance on Mental Health Among Nurses: The Mediating Role of Psychological Capital and Job Satisfaction
pmc-11646404.creator: Jian Zhang, Shazia Rehman, Abdullah Addas, Jamal Ahmad
pmc-11646404.description: BackgroundNurses constitute the backbone of the healthcare sector, often confronting elevated levels of work-related stress and emotional demands that can profoundly impact their mental well-being. Mental health is critical to nursing practice as it directly influences job performance, patient care quality, and workforce sustainability.

pmc-12554131.title: Perspective on alcohol-induced organ damage via autophagy-dependent cellular changes
pmc-12554131.creator: Ahmed Bakheet, Murugadas Anbazhagan, Shirish Barve, Srinivasan Dasarathy, John J Dickinson, Wen-Xing Ding, Terrence M Donohue Jr, Thiyagarajan Gopal, Anna Gukovskaya, Kusum K Kharbanda, John J Lemasters, Natalia A Osna, Pal Pacher, Lucy Sloan, Luis F Vilches, Saraswathi Viswanathan, Xiao-Ming Yin, Z
pmc-12554131.description: Alcohol-induced organ damage is a major global health concern and a leading cause of disability and mortality. In addition to the liver, chronic alcohol consumption adversely affects multiple organ systems, including the cardiovascular and neuromuscular systems, the gastrointestinal tract, adipose tissue, kidneys, pancreas, and the brain.

pmc-12651043.title: Structural Alterations of Human Erythrocytes Induced by Minocycline
pmc-12651043.creator: Elena Baeva, Marina Holyavka, Valery Artyukhov, Maxim Kondratyev, Roger Schneiter, Anna Bogdanova, Lars Kaestner
pmc-12651043.description: The non-antibacterial effects of the tetracycline antibiotic minocycline on human erythrocytes are currently under investigation. Our data indicate alterations in the surface structure of erythrocytes; the antibiotic promotes the redistribution of cellular transformational forms during preliminary in vitro incubation (1 h and 24 h) with the modifier.

pmc-12999785.title: Artificial intelligence modeling and investigation of metal organic frameworks in drug delivery: modeling of loading capacity and toxicity behavior
pmc-12999785.creator: Yinglian Qin, Shili Li, Javed Iqbal, Saeed Shirazian
pmc-12999785.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this work, our aim was to develop predictive models of Drug Loading Capacity (g/g) and Cell Viability (%) in MOFs (Metal Organic Frameworks) for evaluation of these materials in drug delivery applications and assess their performance. We employed Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) and its advanced variants: Sparse Gaussian Process Regression (SGPR) and Deep Gaussian Process Regression (DGPR) as the base of our modeling framework to estimate the target values.

pmc-13234177.title: Genomic investigation of Mycobacterium bovis in bulk unpasteurized dairy products in Ardabil Province, Iran
pmc-13234177.creator: Faraz Malek Bagali, Hamid Reza Abedi, Mahdi Rezaverdinejad, Farzad Khademi
pmc-13234177.description: Zoonotic tuberculosis is predominantly caused by Mycobacterium bovis. Given the paucity of molecular data on this pathogen and the prominence of the traditional dairy industry in Ardabil Province, this study aimed to investigate the genomic presence of M. bovis in unpasteurized dairy products using a multi-gene targeting approach.

pmc-13587563.creator: Marc Carrascosa-Sàez, Rodrigo Arce, Jérémy Dufloo, Rafael Sanjuán
pmc-13587563.description: that causes severe hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) in humans [1,2]. Transmission to humans usually occurs through contact with aerosols from secretions or excretions of infected rodents. Although several seasonal outbreaks occur regularly, mainly in Chile and Argentina, transmission chains are usually short-lived and involve limited person-to-person transmission [3,4].

pmc-13633073.title: Sequential Contralateral Large-Vessel Occlusion Following Intravenous Thrombolysis: A Case Report of Dynamic Bilateral Cerebral Arterial Thrombosis
pmc-13633073.creator: M. A. Sayed Joy, Mohsin Fayyaz, Manasi Limaye, Amrita Kiran, Amir A Khan, Ayesha Amjad, Feven A Kenea, Mohammad Siddiqui
pmc-13633073.description: Acute large-vessel occlusion stroke can evolve rapidly during the hyperacute treatment period, occasionally resulting in a clinical and radiological picture that differs substantially from the initial presentation. We report an unusual case of sequential contralateral large-vessel occlusion occurring within approximately three hours. A patient presented with transient dysphasia that resolved rapidly.
